excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
- Lodestar does not prune by default right now but it can be opted into via `--chain.pruneHistory` flag
- it's 133 GB on my node, it includes blocks (with EL payloads) up to 5 months and blobs of the last ~18 days
